name: Byakko no Gai
source:
Earth Age: 19 years old.
Special Trait: His fangs that get longer when he's excited, there's a rumor you'll get infected if they pierce you
Element: Earth
Abilities: Can control physical force/Owns the Byakko Armor/Defense Type

Energetic, bright, and innocent, the type who is always straightforward with his emotions and says what's on his mind.
But truly on the inside he's naive and gets hurt easily.
He easily gets lonely and likes to be spoiled, but he has a backbone.
